title: An Improved Upper Bound for the Signed Third Autocorrelation Constant C_1d (N = 819,200 Exact Certificate)
description: Exact rational step-function certificate establishing C_1d <= 1949516888592680059852669907037867980800 / 1343285009105095348743847474054775337361 = 1.4513054752925889347... <= 1.451305475292589 for the signed third autocorrelation constant (constant 1d in teorth/optimizationproblems; Problem 6.4 of arXiv:2511.02864). Includes the N = 819,200 integer step-function certificate (c1d_upper_n819200.json.gz), two independent zero-dependency Python 3 standard-library exact verifiers (Kronecker big-integer substitution and 3-prime 60-bit NTT with Garner CRT), off-knot exact overlap integration and adversarial rejection controls, CUDA fp64 optimizer, SHA-256 checksums, and LaTeX/PDF manuscript.
